title: Global Newland L-Shaped Desk with Double Pedestals — 72"W x 78"D
body_html:
A full corner workstation in one package — 72 inches of desk, a deep return, and two lockable pedestals that put filing within arm's reach.

The Global Newland L-shaped desk anchors a private office with a 72"W x 78"D corner footprint and two hanging box/file pedestals for lockable document and supply storage. A 1" thermally fused laminate top with a 2 mm matching edge stands up to daily institutional use, while leveling glides keep the surface true on uneven floors. Built in Canada and reversible for left- or right-hand layouts, it assembles quickly and adapts to almost any room.

Key features

  • L-shaped layout pairs a 72"W desk with a return for a full 78"D footprint
  • Two hanging box/file pedestals deliver lockable file and supply storage
  • 1" thermally fused laminate top with durable 2 mm matching edge
  • Leveling glides keep the surface true on uneven institutional floors
  • Reversible build assembles for left- or right-hand applications
  • Designed for quick and easy assembly

Who it’s for

Private offices and managerial workstations in municipal, education, and healthcare administration environments that need generous worksurface area plus built-in lockable storage.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
